description: Defines the uci_pusch_pdu_builder class, a builder for constructing and setting parameters of uci_pusch_pdu objects, including methods for setting UE-specific parameters, metrics, HARQ, and CSI parts, based on specifications in SCF-222 v4.0.

classes.name: uci_pusch_pdu_builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing and configuring uci_pusch_pdu objects with various parameters.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets UE-specific parameters in the PDU, such as RNTI.

methods.name: set_metrics_parameters
methods.description: Sets metrics parameters including UL SINR, RSSI, and RSRP, with validation.

methods.name: set_harq_parameters
methods.description: Sets HARQ parameters for the PDU.

methods.name: set_csi_part1_parameters
methods.description: Sets CSI Part 1 parameters in the PDU.

methods.name: set_csi_part2_parameters
methods.description: Sets CSI Part 2 parameters in the PDU.
